sources.title: Ouro Kronii (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It consists of a [[white shirt|white]] [[sleeveless shirt]] with a [[cleavage cutout]] and a [[white sailor collar]], worn over a [[black shirt|black]] [[pinstripe shirt|pinstripe]] [[crop top|cropped]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]] with a golden [[zipper]] that reveals her [[underboob]], a [[blue bowtie]] with a [[heart brooch]] with a  [[heart-shaped gem]], [[black sleeves|black]]/dark [[grey sleeves|grey]] [[frilled sleeves|frilled]] [[detached sleeves|detached]] [[juliet sleeves]], [[black gloves]], a [[black skirt|black]] [[frilled skirt|frilled]] [[pinstripe skirt|pinstripe]] [[half-skirt|half]] [[miniskirt]], [[black thighhighs]], and [[blue boots|blue]]  [[high heel boots|high-heel]] [[ankle boots]].
